lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Restraints, Open Truck Beds & Unattended Children
prompt: Under Texas Penal Code §22.10, when is leaving a child unattended inside a motor vehicle a crime?

options.text: Child younger than 12 left unattended for >15 mins while running errands
Only if the outdoor ambient temperature exceeds ninety degrees Fahrenheit
Child younger than 7 left unattended for >5 mins without someone ≥14 years old
Leaving a child inside a parked car is never illegal if windows are cracked
